headline: ATL @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 3.60 at LAD 3.95, with a projected total of 7.55. Movement note: ATL run projection moved -0.72, from 4.32 to 3.60. Batter research is strongest for Ozzie Albies, Kyle Tucker, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
